$comment: Every screen, in sidebar order. `/` opens the home screen chosen in Appearance. `look` is the look a screen was designed in, used by the 'Per screen' look. The five `places` are the short sidebar; the rest go under More.

screens.label: Overview
screens.summary: Current state: indicator contacts, exploited CVEs on devices, new devices, network checks, gaps.

screens.label: Fleet
screens.summary: Devices from Pi-hole's network table, ARP and sweeps, merged by MAC.

screens.label: Targeted check
screens.summary: Check an address, MAC, hostname, network or domain.

screens.label: Pi-hole Sentinel
screens.summary: DNS source: connection, indicator hunt, coverage, denylist pushes, live watch.

screens.label: CVEs
screens.summary: CVEs from NVD and CISA KEV; vendor exploitation reports; matches against device software.

screens.label: Sites
screens.summary: Other TheySpy instances read through their read-only API.

screens.label: This device
screens.summary: Checks run from this browser: browser and OS CVEs, GPC, ad blocking, DNS path.

screens.label: Ad exposure
screens.summary: Per-device and network checks with evidence and fix; hardening kits.

screens.label: Indicators
screens.summary: zero-breach's indicator set: provenance, verification, updates, exports.

screens.label: Baselines
screens.summary: Blocking levels per device or network, previewed against DNS history.

screens.label: Blocklist library
screens.summary: DNS blocklists by category: discovery, versions, update gates, subscription addresses.

screens.label: Evidence locker
screens.summary: Findings from the agent, MVT and network logs; TLS fingerprints; checks that could not run.

screens.label: Briefing
screens.summary: Daily or weekly digest; alerts; API tokens.

screens.label: Appearance
screens.summary: Look, name, logo, accent, home screen, density.
